title: Base Power footer
description: A deep forest-green footer: five columns of white links under small grey uppercase headings, dark download badges on the right, a contact row with social icons, the company name set huge and faint across the full width, then a hairline, the small print, a round seal and a lime uppercase sign-off. Two columns on phones.
notes: the giant name is an SVG word stretched to the width (short names read best)
badges and the seal are plain text (no store or certifier logos)
